profile.headline: B.S. in Physics from San Diego State University
profile.summary: Physics B.S. graduate from San Diego State University. My career goals include developing solutions for global issues like climate change, poverty and equality and effect real change in people's lives through use of technology and energy solutions.

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description: Providing an excellent customer experience, while stocking, managing inventory, training, and cleaning.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Using computational materials databases, 2D & 3D material simulations are run within AMS to identify optimal chemical and physical properties to improve the fabrication process. Simulation data is then used to train learning models to predict the best material combinations for certain properties. As an end goal for the machine learning team, the entire process from database retrieval to end result is currently being automated. The overall goal of the lab is to improve upon the glassy carbon design of the lab's brain computer interface chip.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · AMS · Machine Learning · ReaxFF · Molecular Dynamics

positions.title: Robotics Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Assembled and integrated vision inspection robots for QA: IR & cap testing and sorting of components process automation. Designed new inspection robot for 100 distinct components alongside senior engineers.  Created computer vision program for real time position and angle of <1mm parts in python.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Computer Vision · Systems Assembly · Systems Design · Process Automation

positions.title: Front of House
positions.description: Front of house experience: food preparation, line cook, money handling, custodial, hosting. Grubby's has provided me with a means to financially support myself along side my schooling so that I may further my education.

positions.title: Field Technician
positions.description: Field Nation services I've performed have ranged from installing computer hardware/OS and third-party software, audio/video, networking, and troubleshooting any of the above. This position helped me to hone  technical skills and apply my education and past experiences to create outstanding technical solutions. This position improved my self management abilities as usually I was the only Field Nation representative on site supervising the quality of service and ensuring project result satisfaction.
positions.insights: Skills: Audio Visual (AV) Systems · Computer Hardware · Troubleshooting · Self Management · Cable Routing

positions.title: Level 3 Associate
positions.description: At In-N-Out, my roles varied between, order taking and money handling, custodial duties, food preparation , hosting and managing the drive lane. This work experience instilled in me the importance of teamwork and providing the highest quality customer service possible.
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Service · Communication · Teamwork · Problem Solving · Endurance

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: The objective of this internship was to program an array of microcomputers to run continuous speed reports on ViaSat's satellite network services, and store the data on a remote server for later analysis. I learned how to navigate ARM architecture, linux based OS and Python. I also picked up essential problem solving skills that applied to my future academics and work experiences.
